reason: All named individual characters in this text are either royalty/rulers (Ahaziah, Jehoram, Jehoshaphat), prophets with divine authority and supernatural powers (Elijah, Elisha), or military officers (captains of fifty). While the text mentions unnamed groups such as 'men of the city' (אַנְשֵׁי הָעִיר) and 'small children' who could be considered regular people, they are not named as individuals. Every named character possesses either political authority, prophetic status, or military rank.
